title: Client Discovery Harness - Project
description: One analysis engagement. The four language axes (ui_lang, source language on each SourceMetadata, target_countries, output_lang) are independent by design: an operator may work in Korean on Vietnamese sources and produce English output.

market_scope.description: Domestic and international use the same engine; this field and the country fields are the only distinction.

storage_mode.description: EPHEMERAL is the default and the public build's only supported mode. PERSISTENT is chosen by the adopting organisation, not by the core.
